verdict.rationale: The docs say the dot can use a Google Drive connection to read and update documents, can work with local files on a connected computer, can update a checklist, and runs on its own cloud computer. This shows editing of existing documents, but creating new files, presentations, and export are not shown. missing for 10: explicit document/file creation, presentation creation, iterative editing workflow, export to downloadable formats, hands-on corroboration.
